page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m1.small is an entry-level virtual server belonging to the shared-core ecs.s6 family. The instance is powered by a KVM hypervisor and runs on the x86_64 architecture. Compute is driven by a single shared vCPU derived from an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The server is configured with 1.0 GB of system memory, resulting in an exact 1:1 ratio of memory to compute cores. It does not include dedicated graphics processing units, possessing a GPU count of zero.

Storage and networking profiles reflect its minimal hardware allocation. The instance includes no local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for the operating system and persistent data. Baseline network bandwidth is listed at 0 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with the machine. Because CPU resources are allocated on a shared basis, performance is subject to multi-tenant virtualization contention, trading off dedicated throughput for lower infrastructure overhead.

Given its minimal memory capacity and shared compute allocation, this instance represents a cost-efficient hardware profile for lightweight tasks with low resource consumption. Tradeoffs include low compute headroom and the absence of bundled local storage. Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m1.small is best suited for non-production environments, developer sandboxes, lightweight automation scripts, low-volume background tasks, and basic testing workloads.
